items.title: AI infrastructure stocks surge after strong earnings from CoreWeave, Supermicro
items.summary: AI infrastructure stocks jumped, with shares of AI server makers, optical-products companies, and neocloud providers moving higher.

items.title: Coherent's Record Year Produced Almost No Cash
items.summary: Operating cash flow fell 87% to $79.5 million while capital spending topped $1.1 billion

items.title: Lumentum Still Down Over 90 Days: A Respected Analyst Sees 22% Gains Ahead Following Sharp Upturn
items.summary: Lumentum blew past earnings estimates and still trades below where it was three months ago, leaving a respected semiconductor analyst convinced the selloff created an opening the market has not yet closed.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures: Cisco, Coherent Are Earnings Losers After Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave Lead AI Rally
items.summary: AI stocks led the market Wednesday, fueled by Nebius, Lumentum, CoreWeave and Super Micro. Cisco and Coherent were earnings movers late.

items.title: Coherent, Cerebras, Cisco, StubHub, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Cisco and Coherent both slide despite solid earnings, while StubHub plummets as higher costs offset a World Cup boost.

items.title: Korea’s Stock Market Surges Another 3.5% Overnight. Intel, Coherent, and Micron Among Most Active Premarket Stocks in US Trading.
items.summary: South Korean memory stocks just posted their biggest surge in months while U.S. premarket tells a far more complicated story, with Coherent falling despite a beat and Micron moving in the opposite direction from its Asian peers.

items.title: Coherent Delivers Strong Q4 Beat and Bullish FY27 Outlook, but Shares Fall 5%
items.summary: Coherent Corp. (NYSE:COHR) delivered stronger-than-expected fourth-quarter results and issued an ambitious outlook for fiscal 2027, supported by robust customer demand and expanding production capacity.

items.title: Coherent Stock Drops Despite Earnings Beat and Strong Outlook
items.summary: Coherent beat earnings and revenue estimates and offered a stronger-than-expected outlook as demand for its optical-networking technology grows with AI infrastructure.
